title: Badminton to Pickleball Transition (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 134bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
From the shuttle to the ball
From the racket to the paddle
The wrist is different now
The arm is different now

[Verse 1]
Badminton wrist flicks fast and snap
Pickleball wrist quiet stays in lap
Badminton paddle long and light
Pickleball paddle short and tight
Vamos vamos arm not wrist
Uno dos tres slow the twist
Shoulder swings the paddle through
Wrist stays still the whole way true

[Pre-Chorus]
Quiet wrist
Full arm
Quiet wrist
No harm

[Chorus]
Badminton to pickleball badminton to pickleball
Quiet wrist full arm quiet wrist
Badminton to pickleball badminton to pickleball
Vamos amigos no twist

[Verse 2]
Badminton ball flies high and floats
Pickleball ball low and notes
Get low bend the knees deep
Waist height contact zone keep
Uno dos tres knees deep
Mano firme the paddle reap
No wrist flick on the volley
Full arm punch on the trolley

[Bridge]
No high overhead snap
No wrist flick on the tap
The arm and shoulder do the work
The wrist stays calm no jerk

[Chorus]
Badminton to pickleball badminton to pickleball
Quiet wrist full arm quiet wrist
Badminton to pickleball badminton to pickleball
Vamos amigos no twist

[Outro]
Quiet wrist
Full arm
Quiet wrist
No harm
